title: Evaluation question execution
description: Executes one evaluation question with streaming as the first turn of a new evaluation conversation on an agent version, given as `agentVersion` (the current published version or a preview of an enabled agent) or as `agent` together with `candidate: true` (the agent's current candidate, validated like a publish and frozen as a preview, reused while the candidate is unchanged). Both ways in one body, or neither, are rejected with 422. Single executions are never measured, so the run options of the run start (such as a mode) are not accepted.

agentVersion.title: Agent version
agentVersion.description: The agent version to execute the question on: IRI (`/api/agent_versions/<uuid>`) or full UUID. It must be the current published version or a preview of an enabled agent; otherwise the request is rejected with 422. Not combined with `agent` or `candidate`.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The agent whose candidate the question is executed on: IRI (`/api/agents/<uuid>`), full UUID or slug; only together with `candidate: true` and without `agentVersion`. An unknown or disabled agent and an invalid candidate (at `candidate/<field>`, as on publish) are rejected with 422.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: `true`: execute on a preview of the current candidate of `agent`. Only together with `agent`; `false` is rejected with 422.
